summary: Recommended Council give first, second and third reading to Fire Prevention and Regulation Bylaw No. 1665, 2026 and the Fire Prevention and Regulation Miscellaneous Amending Bylaw No. 2286, 2026. The Committee approved the agenda as presented and adopted the Special Community Advisory Committee minutes of July 7, 2026. Committee members asked questions of the Fire Chief and legislative staff during the report on the proposed bylaw.
